responsibility: Defines the `rustc_middle::hir` module’s shared HIR-side data and query wiring. It owns the `ModuleItems` summary type used to partition and iterate local item-like definitions, adds `TyCtxt` helpers for module/impl classification and owner-node hashing, and registers the HIR-related query providers that connect crate HIR storage to middle-layer consumers.
same_name_distinction: Unlike `hir/map/mod.rs`, which performs the actual HIR indexing and lookup work, this `mod.rs` is the `hir` module root: it defines shared owner/attribute storage types and installs the HIR queries/providers that expose those structures through `TyCtxt`.
